items.text:
English lesson practice — Lesson-05: Thanks for your work
Use the cited NCTB 2026 textbook section where required; textbook/audio not included.
Imagine a person whose work helps your community. Describe the person’s work and explain its value. No fixed word count is imposed for this lesson task.
items.explanation:
A cleaner helps to keep the lane near our home tidy. She starts work early and sweeps the common spaces carefully. She collects waste using suitable tools and places it in the collection area. Her work makes the lane more pleasant for everyone. If rubbish were left there, it could pile up and create unhealthy conditions. We should not make her work harder by throwing litter on the ground. I can help by using the correct bins and keeping sharp waste safely separated for responsible adults to manage. I respect her work and thank her for her service.

Addresses the task with relevant details
Uses a clear sequence and connected sentences
Uses suitable vocabulary and comprehensible grammar
Accept original accurate responses; do not require memorisation
Original imagined community example; working hours, actions and identity are not additional facts about Bulbul. Illness is not the worker’s fault; pupils should not handle hazardous waste.
